statement: The catalogue accurately describes the scope and limits of Ardıç’s 2025 Turkish article. The comparison itself is exhibit-based, with selected examples on pp. 87–90, and p. 90 n. 22 points to a companion interpretation for a complete sentence. P. 80 n. 14 points to a separate, explicitly unfinished ATA table. Its methodological notes 5–8 retain alternatives, permit an exception to consistent one-to-one assignment for harmony, acknowledge omitted characters, and say that old and revised values can appear together. Row 10 also relies on an illustrated bridge traversal order. The separate f33v proceedings article, version pp. 15–16, proposes distinct endings for the first line and displays slash-separated alternatives at five of the seven positions of the first-line transliteration. Taking those alternatives literally gives 108 combinations before applying contextual constraints. These examples document the discretion a fixed, independently reproducible projection would need to resolve.
